title: Fade
author: Lisa McMann
current_text: The Jay School Corporation removed Fade by Lisa McMann in March 2022.

sources.quote: The Jay School Corporation removed “Fade” by Lisa McMann in March 2022, but documents provided by the district did not specify a reason.
sources.title: ‘Questionable’ Content, ‘Graphic’ Imagery Lead To Book Bans At Indiana School Libraries - InkFreeNews.com
